vendors.description: Health, medical, and prescription insurance coverage for active municipal and school employees and eligible retired public servants.

vendors.vendorName: Appraisal Systems, Inc. (ASI) — Citywide Property Revaluation Contract
vendors.description: Special emergency multi-year contract ordered by the Passaic County Board of Taxation to inspect and revalue all ~24,745 Clifton parcels to 100% market value (first revaluation since 1990).
